function.description: Read YOUR action cards from the card store: every open card (id, exact command, reason) and every card decided in the last hours with its outcome (sent, cancelled, replaced, expired) and, for a payment that landed, its tx hash. Use it before you tell the owner what is open, paid or owed, before you write a tx hash anywhere, and before you raise or replace a card. With cancel=<id> it withdraws one open card you raised; otherwise nothing changes.
function.name: cards_read

cancel.description: The id of an OPEN card YOU raised that is no longer needed: it closes as cancelled and nothing runs. A card the system raised (a quote) stays the owner's. Empty: only read.

hours.description: How far back to list the decided cards (default 24 h).
